title: What a pilot report looks like.
summary: The acceptance scorecard a process owner receives at the end of a build-and-pilot phase. Illustrative, not client data.

body.callout: The figures below are illustrative, not client data. When we publish our own implementations they appear in the same five-field format, including the measures that did not move.

decision.title: Expand, improve or stop.
decision.body: Six of seven measures met. The exception rate missed because one vendor's statements arrive as scanned images; the fix is scoped at two weeks. Recommendation: expand to the remaining entities, with the scan fix in the first sprint.
decision.signed: the process owner, the finance contact and xGold.
